caption: The drawing features a model of a grasshopper, constructed from various wooden objects. The body consists of a horizontally placed cylindrical log with a pointed front end, which mimics the head and thorax of the insect. Two long, narrow sticks are attached at angles on top of the body to represent the grasshopper's bent hind legs. Smaller sticks with a curve act as the insect's antennae, protruding from the head area. The underside segment of the model is made from a rounded, ribbed piece, colored a pale yellow, depicting the grasshopper's abdomen. The entire figure is mounted upright on a vertical cylindrical base colored brown with a dark blue or black ring near the top. The color palette consists of muted browns, yellows, greens, and grays, which contributes to a natural, wooden appearance for the object modeled after a grasshopper. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present.
title: Grasshopper Weather Vane
